description: This file defines a Dagger module named 'FingerprintModule' for dependency injection related to fingerprint authentication functionalities in an Android application. It provides various system services and cryptographic components such as FingerprintManager, KeyguardManager, KeyStore, KeyPairGenerator, Signature, InputMethodManager, shared preferences, and a backend store implementation, tailored for fingerprint authentication features.

classes.name: FingerprintModule
classes.description: A Dagger module class that provides dependencies required for fingerprint authentication, including system services and cryptographic utilities.

methods.name: providesContext
methods.description: Returns the context instance passed in the constructor.

methods.name: providesKeystore
methods.description: Provides an instance of java.security.KeyStore for AndroidKeyStore.

methods.name: providesKeyPairGenerator
methods.description: Provides a KeyPairGenerator instance initialized for EC keys in the AndroidKeyStore.

methods.name: providesSignature
methods.description: Provides a Signature instance for SHA256withECDSA.

methods.name: providesSharedPreferences
methods.description: Provides default shared preferences for the context.

methods.name: providesStoreBackend
methods.description: Provides an instance of StoreBackend, implemented by StoreBackendImpl.
